mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_path WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_onboarding_path SET name=#{name},target_role=#{targetRole},description=#{description},knowledge_snapshot_id=#{knowledgeSnapshotId} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE sa_onboarding_path SET status='PUBLISHED',version_no=version_no+1,published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_path ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{query.pageSize}
SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_path_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_path_task WHERE path_id=#{pathId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_task_dependency WHERE path_id=#{pathId} ORDER BY task_id,prerequisite_task_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sa_onboarding_task_dependency WHERE task_id=#{taskId} OR prerequisite_task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_onboarding_path_task SET sort_order=#{sortOrder} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sa_content_dependency WHERE target_type='PATH_TASK' AND target_id=#{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_content_dependency(project_id,source_document_id,source_version_id,target_type,target_id) SELECT #{projectId},document_id,id,'PATH_TASK',#{taskId} FROM sa_document_version WHERE id=#{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.id FROM sa_onboarding_path_task t JOIN sa_content_dependency d ON (d.target_type='PATH_TASK' AND d.target_id=t.id OR d.target_type=t.resource_type AND d.target_id=t.resource_id) WHERE t.path_id=#{pathId} AND d.review_status='NEEDS_REVIEW'
SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_assignment WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_assignment_task WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_onboarding_assignment_task SET prerequisite_task_ids_json=CAST(#{prerequisiteTaskIdsJson} AS JSON),status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE sa_onboarding_assignment_task SET status=#{task.status},quiz_attempt_id=#{task.quizAttemptId},drill_run_id=#{task.drillRunId}, opened_at=COALESCE(opened_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),completed_at=#{task.completedAt},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{task.id} AND assignment_id=#{task.assignmentId} AND status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sa_onboarding_assignment ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{query.pageSize}
